required_harness_change: Private host only: log pre/post registered IRC/DBIN, latch qualifiers, actual accepted Phi2 enable, DIN, ASn/address, Ecounter and transaction count at each existing tick in the already observed IACK+256-mastertick windows. No extra tick/eval/input/ROM/RAM/reset writes; same61-field prefix.

latch_rule.DBIN: xToDbin && Clks.enPhi2; qualify selected bytes using dbinNoLow/dbinNoHigh/byteMux

clock_type_source.text: logic enPhi1, enPhi2;	// Clock enables. Next cycle is PHI1 or PHI2
input enPhi1, enPhi2,	// Clock enables. Next cycle is PHI1 or PHI2

qualification_before_launch: Resolve accepted Phi2 from the exact current donor clock struct or proved top-level enable connection; do not infer from post-edge phase alone.
Verify registered qualifier names actually present in a freshly private generated model.
Use immutable run metadata with privatehost/source/executable pins and terminal exit.
decisive_fidelity_check: All19 existing probe images byte-identical and instruction-events byte-identical.
Every qualified Phi2 IRC/DBIN latch transition carries pre-edge DIN and qualifier values.
Correlate IACK/VMA edges with actual vector-data latch, not board request counter alone.
limitations: Existing header is availability evidence from the earlier system model, not proof of fresh private probe compilation.
Matching MAME CPU-space IACK observer still needed; ordinary vector-table tap does not observe that CPU-space event.
